title: NSF Graduate Research Fellowship Program (GRFP)
eligibility: U.S. citizens, nationals, or permanent residents who are seniors, bachelor's holders with no grad enrollment, or first-year grad students entering research-based STEM programs
benefit: $37,000/year stipend plus $16,000/year cost-of-education allowance, 3 years of support over 5
description: FY2027 deadlines vary by field (8 pm ET): Oct 19, 2026 Life Sciences; Oct 20 CISE, Materials, Psychology, Social Sciences; Oct 22 Engineering; Oct 23 Chemistry, Geosciences, Math, Physics & Astronomy. Reference letters due Oct 16, 2026.

title: Hertz Fellowship
eligibility: Promising doctoral students in applied sciences, engineering, and mathematics (see Who Can Apply)
benefit: Up to five years of funding valued at up to $250,000
description: The 2027 Fellowship application is open through October 30, 2026.

title: NDSEG Fellowship
eligibility: U.S. citizens or nationals pursuing doctorates in DoD-relevant science and engineering fields (check eligibility page)
description: The FY2027 application period runs August 3 through October 30, 2026 (5 pm Eastern).

title: DOE Office of Science Graduate Student Research (SCGSR) — thesis research at a national lab
host: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Science
eligibility: PhD students (proof of PhD candidacy) who are U.S. citizens or lawful permanent residents, with their thesis advisor
benefit: Supplemental funds to do part of your PhD thesis research at a DOE national laboratory for 3–12 months
description: Work with a DOE National Laboratory scientist on part of your dissertation. This solicitation is due November 4, 2026 at 5:00 PM ET (2:00 PM Pacific).

title: Boren Fellowship (graduate) — 2027
eligibility: U.S. graduate students studying less commonly taught languages in world regions critical to U.S. interests; recipients commit to federal service
benefit: Funding for overseas language study and research (see the Boren Awards site for amounts)
description: National deadline for 2027 Boren Fellowships is January 20, 2027 (Boren Awards site). Berkeley applicants: check the campus process with the OURS scholarships office first.

title: LANL Remote Sensing Summer School — summer 2027
eligibility: U.S. citizens or U.S. persons enrolled in a graduate program when applying
benefit: Paid, in-person 10-week research program (June 7–Aug 13, 2027); up to 10 students
description: Remote sensing and advanced imaging research (hyperspectral, radar, AI/ML image analysis) with Los Alamos scientists, ending in a symposium talk, poster and report. Applications accepted October 12, 2026 to January 10, 2027.
